send_media.beforeRequest: const type=inputs.media_type,method={photo:'sendPhoto',video:'sendVideo',sticker:'sendSticker',animation:'sendAnimation'}[type];if(!method)throw new Error('Unknown media type method ('+type+')');const media=inputs.media?JSON.parse(inputs.media):{},id=media[type+'Id'];if(id===undefined||id==='')throw new Error('No media defined. Provide either a file or an id.');request.url='/'+method;request.body[type]=id;if(type==='animation'&&typeof media.duration==='number')request.body.duration=media.duration;if(request.body.parse_mode==='None')delete request.body.parse_mode;return request;

send_media_group.beforeRequest: const items=inputs.media?JSON.parse(inputs.media):[];if(items.length<2||items.length>10)throw new Error('A media group must contain 2–10 media items.');const mode=inputs.parse_mode&&inputs.parse_mode!=='None'?inputs.parse_mode:undefined;request.body.media=items.map(item=>{const entry={type:String(item.type??'photo'),media:String(item.media??'')};if(!entry.media)throw new Error('Each media item must define a URL or file_id.');if(item.caption){entry.caption=String(item.caption);if(mode)entry.parse_mode=mode;}return entry;});return request;

send_poll.label: Send Poll
send_poll.description: Send a native Telegram poll (regular or quiz) to a chat

chat_id.label: Chat ID
chat_id.description: Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target channel (e.g. @channelusername).

options.label: Options
options.description: List of answer options (2–10 options, each 1–100 characters), such as ["Yes", "No"].

is_anonymous.label: Anonymous
is_anonymous.description: True, if the poll needs to be anonymous. Default true.

allows_multiple_answers.label: Allow Multiple Answers
allows_multiple_answers.description: True if the poll allows multiple answers (regular polls only).

correct_option_id.label: Correct Option ID (Quiz)
correct_option_id.description: 0-based index of the correct answer option (required for quizzes).

explanation.label: Explanation (Quiz)
explanation.description: Explanation shown when a user picks an incorrect answer (0–200 chars).

explanation_parse_mode.label: Explanation Format
explanation_parse_mode.description: How the quiz explanation should be parsed by Telegram.

open_period.label: Open Period (seconds)
open_period.description: Amount of time in seconds the poll will be active (5–600).

close_date.label: Close Date
close_date.description: Point in time when the poll will be automatically closed, such as 2026-12-01T10:00:00Z.

is_closed.label: Closed
is_closed.description: Pass True if the poll should be immediately closed. Useful for previews.

message_thread_id.label: Message Thread ID
message_thread_id.description: Unique identifier for the target message thread of the forum; supergroup forums only.

disable_notification.label: Disable Notification
disable_notification.description: Send the message silently. Users will receive a notification with no sound.

protect_content.label: Protect Content
protect_content.description: Protects the contents of the sent message from forwarding and saving.

reply_to_message_id.label: Reply To Message ID
reply_to_message_id.description: If the message is a reply, ID of the original message.

reply_markup.label: Reply Markup
reply_markup.description: Additional interface options. A JSON-serialized object for an inline keyboard, custom reply keyboard, instructions to remove reply keyboard or to force a reply from the user.

send_poll.beforeRequest: const body=request.body,options=(inputs.options?JSON.parse(inputs.options):[]).map(option=>String(option));if(options.length<2||options.length>10)throw new Error('A poll requires between 2 and 10 options.');body.options=options;body.type=body.type??'regular';const correct=body.correct_option_id;if(body.type==='quiz'){if(correct===undefined)throw new Error('Quiz polls require "Correct Option".');if(correct<0||correct>=options.length)throw new Error('"Correct Option" must be between 0 and '+(options.length-1)+' (the index of an option).');if(body.allows_multiple_answers)throw new Error('Quiz polls cannot allow multiple answers.');}else if(correct!==undefined)throw new Error('"Correct Option" is only valid for quiz polls. Set "Poll Type" to Quiz or clear this field.');if(body.open_period&&inputs.close_date)throw new Error('"Open Period" and "Close Date" are mutually exclusive — set at most one.');if(inputs.close_date)body.close_date=Math.floor(new Date(inputs.close_date).getTime()/1000);if(body.explanation_parse_mode==='None')delete body.explanation_parse_mode;return request;
